selfHostedHelp: Using the open-source edition? Connect to your own server or a nearby till. No Posnic Cloud account required.
pinTimeout: Unlock took too long. Try again, or sign in with your password to reset the PIN.

authorizeInBrowser: Approve in your browser, then return here. Matching code:

accountServiceUnavailable: Account connection is not available on the server yet. You can connect a local shop below.
emptyCart: Add items to start a sale.
name: Name
trainingHelp: Practice sales stay on this device and are never uploaded.
welcome: Your shop. Ready in your pocket.
connectHelp: Sign in to your shop, or try a training sale.
